messages:
maria: Heads-up — ready to originate RC build 2026.03.15-rc1 (artifact: gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026.03.15-rc1). Asking for quick sign-offs on DB migration flag defaults and rollback rules. Requesting quiet window 02:00-04:00 UTC tonight.

devin: LGTM on the binary. paste the pin command?

maria: pinned artifact in CI: `gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026.03.15-rc1`. deploy pin will be applied via deploy-bot after signoff.

sasha: @maria what are rollback thresholds? need explicit criteria for latency vs errors. Also do we have canary shims ready?

maria: rollback plan: immediate traffic shift back to `inference:2026.03.14-prod` if p95 latency increases >10% OR error-rate increases >0.5% sustained for 3m. Canary plan: 5% for 15m, then 25% for 15m, then 100% if stable. KV warm + smoke tests before canary.

kevin: confirm DB migration flag name and default? we can't flip DB migration automatically.

maria: flag `rc_db_v2` defaults to false. migration is opt-in and documented in release notes. We will not enable it during initial promo.

deploy-bot: deploy request received — artifact=gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026.03.15-rc1, env=prod, route=canary(5%), window=2026-03-16T02:00Z..2026-03-16T04:00Z. Planned actions: kv-warm, schema-check, smoke tests.

olivia: release notes draft posted: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/2026-03-15-rc1 — includes DB steps, feature-flag guidance, and rollback commands.

devin: running local smoke now, +1 after green.

sasha: I'll run infra load test (5m). will report back.

kevin: +1 for flag default and rollback criteria as described.

maria: thanks all. initiating deploybot pin now.

deploy-bot: pinned artifact gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026.03.15-rc1 -> ref=rc-pins/2026-03-15 by user maria.

maria: starting canary rollout at ~02:05 UTC. I'll watch p95 and error-rate closely. Oncall: @sre-rotation please monitor dashboards and be ready to abort.

sre-rotation: acknowledged — we'll watch pods, mem, p95, and error-rate. ready to run rollback if thresholds met.

maria: promo plan: 5% at 02:05, 25% at ~02:20, 100% at ~02:50 if no regressions. Abort/rollback target: inference:2026.03.14-prod.

devin: prepared rollback snippet: `deployctl promote --to gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026.03.14-prod --reason "auto-rollback p95"` (keeps route config).

sasha: load test results — no p95 regression, memory stable. proceeding.

olivia: release notes updated with explicit rollback example and feature flag snippet.

maria: canary -> 25% now. Monitoring.

deploy-bot: traffic shifted: 25% -> gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026.03.15-rc1. Smoke tests passed.

sre-rotation: metrics ok so far (15m). no spike.

maria: promoting to 100% in 30m if stable. final signoffs: devin +1, sasha +1, kevin +1, olivia +1. :tada:

deploy-bot: Promotion complete — 100% traffic -> gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026.03.15-rc1. No errors reported in last 15m.

sre-rotation: Observability green. Closing thread and updating release ticket with timestamps and rollback rationale.
